title: Funded-lane full parameter sweep (heavy compute, hard budget cap)
context: Backlog (unscheduled) funded-lane task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Heavy full parameter-sweep compute may exceed donated capacity, so this runs in the funded lane against escrow with a hard per-task budget cap that must never be exceeded, plus a public cost ledger (PLAN section 15, CLAUDE.md). It operates on simulated/open data only and emits a provenance-bound sweep dataset.
objective: Run the full caller parameter sweep over the simulated truth set in the funded lane under a hard budget cap, emitting a provenance-bound results dataset and a public cost ledger entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Full parameter sweep runs reproducibly with complete per-cell provenance over simulated/open data only.
Spend never exceeds fundedBudgetUsd; a public cost ledger entry records actual spend against the cap.
No secrets/API keys written to logs, receipts, or committed files.
output: data/sweep/fullsweep-results/ — provenance-bound full parameter-sweep results dataset + cost ledger entry.
